strategyOverviewDesc: With no stations waiting, turning on TX starts repeated CQ. Up to three replies can be worked at once; additional callers remain in the list until you choose Call.
contestYearDesc: Select the WW Digi event year and submission period.
parallelStreamsDesc: Maximum WW Digi QSOs to work at once. Defaults to 1 and supports up to 3.
replaceQueueOnManualTargetDesc: When enabled, double-clicking a station ends queued and active work and calls only the newly selected station.
maxAttemptsDesc: Maximum transmissions while calling one station without a reply.
locationDesc: ARRL/RAC section for US/Canada; other stations default to DX.
categoryBandDesc: All contacts remain in the submitted log.
categoryTransmitterDesc: ONE, TWO, or UNLIMITED Cabrillo category.
operatorsDesc: Comma-separated operator callsigns required for MULTI-OP.
transmitterIdDesc: Default Cabrillo transmitter ID for new QSOs (0 or 1).
practiceConfirmDescription: This temporarily allows WW Digi transmissions outside the contest period. Confirm that you are using a coordinated non-standard frequency and complying with local regulations. Practice QSOs exist only for this practice session and are deleted when practice ends, the frequency changes, or the application exits. They never enter the official contest log or Cabrillo.
transmitBlockedSetupUnconfirmed: Confirm this contest edition before transmitting
transmitBlockedBand: WW Digi is not available on this band
transmitBlockedOutsidePeriod: This WW Digi event is not currently active
attentionContestSetupRequiredDesc: Receive-only operation remains available. Confirm the callsign, grid and category before transmitting.
attentionContestLedgerUnhealthyDesc: The contest log is unavailable. Transmission remains blocked until it recovers.
attentionContestBandUnavailableDesc: WW Digi permits 160, 80, 40, 20, 15 and 10 metres only.
attentionContestOutsidePeriodDesc: Transmission is available from 12:00 UTC Saturday to 12:00 UTC Sunday on the last full August weekend.
cqMaxAttemptsDesc: Stop TX after this many consecutive CQs receive no reply.
cqSelectionPolicyDesc: Selection order when more stations reply than can be worked at once.
authorizedStaleReceiveCyclesDesc: Receive cycles without hearing a selected station before calls to it are paused.
actionAlternateMessageDesc: Confirm that the alternate FT8/FT4 message can be sent, then call this station again.
attentionRepeatedRr73Desc: The other station may be waiting for your 73.
attentionRepeatedExchangeDesc: The other station may not have received your RR73. It will not be resent until you explicitly choose that action.
attentionRecoveryObservingDesc: This QSO continues listening without transmitting automatically. Choose the appropriate action if the other station requests another message.
attentionCqCollectingDesc: {{count}} caller(s) detected in this receive slot.
attentionCandidatesAwaitingAuthorization: TX stopped with {{count}} caller(s) still waiting for selection.
attentionAuthorizationsInvalidDesc: TX stopped after {{count}} selected station(s) were not heard recently.
attentionOtherCyclePaused: QSO waiting on the other cycle
attentionOtherCyclePausedDesc: {{count}} QSO(s) are waiting for their matching cycle. No transmission is generated for them meanwhile.
attentionSessionCompleteDesc: All selected stations have been handled and TX has stopped.
confirmAuthorizeDupeDesc: This same-band FT4/FT8 contact will score zero.
confirmLogCurrentDesc: The directed exchange will be recorded now.
confirmLogCurrentMissingGrid: The missing grid will be submitted as ZZ00.
